CONCRETE STEPS:
1. Emit a flushed progress line at every phase boundary and before and after every model load, generation call, benchmark and subprocess that can take minutes. During long loops emit completed/pending counts at least every 60 seconds; while a child runs, forward its output and emit elapsed/phase heartbeats every 60 seconds. Keep every output gap below 600 seconds, including tool-free reasoning. Use python -u and print(..., flush=True); heartbeat does not extend a measured deadline.
2. Keep tool calls bounded. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most 150-200 lines, with a progress message between calls. Use scripts/experiments/ for experiment entrypoints, tests/python/ for tests and /tmp for throwaway probes. Never write scratch scripts at the repository root.
3. Authenticate objective_candidate_ready_score=1 and its frozen configuration before changing behavior. Add an opt-in objective choice using loss E(x,y)+logsumexp(-E(x,c)) over c in support/refute/insufficient, preserving the original objective and all existing callers. Use the selected LR, hidden width and one update per released label; no extra training passes in the online arms.
4. Fit the initialization on only the 40 development fit worlds from Exp8815; use the held-out development worlds for its predeclared selection and freeze weights, template-empty initial state and cutoff. Never initialize from V754 evaluation labels. Declare numerical_training_calls; this is small CPU energy training, no GGUF load.

Qualify five-check accounting, frozen within-query state, prediction-before-label, delay-eight release, templates added only on released verifier feedback, normalized reusable identity, at most32 templates, deterministic resume, idempotent acknowledgements, atomic weights/templates/pending commit and hard-exit recovery. 6. Freeze 30 fresh 64-query reset streams with varied relation/query structures and three nested seeds [11,23,47]; reserve 12 structurally disjoint retention worlds per stream. Define five arms: original cold combined, pretrained frozen, pretrained calibration-only, pretrained combined, pretrained shuffled-feedback combined. Hold paid checks, labels, initial weights of the four pretrained arms, durability and seed schedules equal. Publish execution readiness only after private CLI replay and original regression controls pass.
7. Before implementation, read CODEX.md and CLAUDE.md and extend the named REQ/SCENARIO in openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md (plus the relevant learning/verification capability); write failing tests first. Reuse current_work_receipt, primary_publication and existing scoped validation rather than copying an old milestone runner. Bind immutable historical authorities, never mutable vNEXT as an old fixture. Validate owned code with scoped pytest and actual unit/child coverage at 100 percent with zero exclusions, Ruff check/format, strict mypy, and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py with owned test paths as positional arguments. Run applicable private E2E-018/021, and E2E-003/004 plus cargo test/fmt/clippy only for native changes. Cold-replay the terminal artifact outside the checkout without PYTHONPATH. Run adversarial_verify.py and verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict on the candidate before publishing. Retain rejected evidence; a failed owned check means disqualified and readiness zero.
